title: Gibbs-weighted noncommutative m5-to-Q transfer obstruction
question: Does replacing the arbitrary state in EXP-001077 by a finite-temperature Gibbs state for K repair the noncommutative transfer from K=A+P and a fifth K-moment to the EXP-001076 Q_sigma bound?

candidate_test.from_EXP_001076: Q_sigma^2 <= (9/4)*m5^(3/10), obtained by squaring the rational ceiling Q_sigma <= (3/2)*m5^(3/20)
candidate_test.meaning: Even a finite-temperature Gibbs state for the abstract energy K does not repair the form-order-only transfer; the Q3 proof needs the actual Hamiltonian/Gibbs comparison, common-core multiplication, and commutator estimates.

scope.not_closed: The witness rejects only a Gibbs-for-K shortcut in an abstract 2x2 form-order family. It is not a counterexample to the actual Q3 Gibbs state, local Hamiltonian, common core, or stronger trace/commutator estimates. All Q3 and QFT gates remain open.

adversarial_review.check: The rational state ratio rho_22/rho_11=L^-6 equals exp(-beta*(L-1)) for beta=6*log(L)/(L-1)>0; the witness is finite-temperature, not a zero-temperature projector.
A and P are explicit rank-one positive matrices and K=A+P is positive diagonal.
The fifth K-moment and Q-squared value are exact rational traces under the same Gibbs state.
The fractional candidate inequality is tested after raising both positive sides to the exact tenth power; no floating-point root or decimal threshold is used.
Each beta is strictly positive and finite; its dependence on L is explicit and no beta-independent Q3 conclusion is attached.
K is an abstract 2x2 energy witness, not the registered interacting Q3 Hamiltonian or its local Gibbs measure.
R260 checks the rational Gibbs ratios, traces, powered comparisons, and scope fixture only; it does not formalize the Q3 representation.
The witness does not alter OS/KMS/GNS, gap, continuum, C6, Sector A, Pre-A, or the TECT production-owner status.

qft_interface.closed: A finite-temperature Gibbs state for the abstract K still does not make form order K=A+P plus one fifth moment sufficient for the scalar Q candidate.
qft_interface.open: Actual Q3 Hamiltonian/Gibbs comparison, translate- and volume-uniform moments, commutator/domain control, P input, modular companion, history, direct D/delta-D Cauchy, exhaustion, Hamiltonian-to-OS identification, KMS/GNS gap, continuum, C6, Sector A and Pre-A remain open.
qft_interface.tect_boundary: No heat_root_incidence or canonical A1/R-192 production owner is supplied.

next_action: Use the actual Q3 Hamiltonian rather than K as the Gibbs generator, and prove a translate- and volume-uniform trace/commutator estimate on the common quartic form core; test any proposed estimate against this finite Gibbs obstruction before promotion.
boundary: T0 claim-nonbearing finite Gibbs-weighted matrix route obstruction.
